name: Default
shortDescription: Feishin web music player for Navidrome, Jellyfin and OpenSubsonic servers, served as a static web app that keeps no server-side data.

alerts.message: Feishin is only a player: it needs an existing Navidrome, Jellyfin or OpenSubsonic server reachable over HTTPS from your browser. Add it under Manage servers on first visit, or preset it with SERVER_URL, SERVER_TYPE and SERVER_NAME.
